steps.content: It's nighttime in Eastside. Towering skyscrapers stretch endlessly into the depths of the streets.

Colorful advertisements play non-stop on the glass curtain walls, featuring TV show trailers, movie promotions, and the pop songs in rotation. The area is filled with a constant hum of the crowd which stimulates the eardrums together with the loud music.
Du Ruo stands in the middle of the street, tilting her head back to take in everything. It takes her three full minutes before she lowers her head to ask you a question.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, is there an event happening here?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's no event. This is just how this place always is, considering it's one of the busiest streets in Eastside.
Hearing this, Du Ruo looks up to scan her surroundings again, taking her time before she's willing to move on. Seeing her barely concealed excitement, you feel somewhat relieved.

Half an hour ago
Outside the MBCC
The vehicle escorting you and Du Ruo for your academic visit to Eastside has arrived, but it's surrounded by a group of unfamiliar guards.

steps.speaker: Policeman
steps.content: Chief, Miss Ambassador, please wear this when you go out.
He hands you and Du Ruo a small earpiece, through which you hear the councilor's not-so-friendly voice.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, it seems you've made a rather significant decision on your own.
This is clearly about your approval of Du Ruo's entry.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The MBCC has submitted Du Ruo's entry agreement. It specifies her range of activities and forbids her from visiting any sensitive area.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Yes, we have received it. But the council wants to supplement it with some necessary measures.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: All of your subsequent actions will be monitored by the council and the 9th Agency. We hope you will cooperate if there are any instructions.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Should there be any violation, we might take the envoy back to the City Council with force for a reassessment of her entry permit.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Force? This is a senior official from Eastia. What are you planning?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Whatever it is that we're planning to do, you would take full responsibility, wouldn't you, Chief?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You...
Just as you are about to argue further, Du Ruo suddenly grabs you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I see. I will do as you ask. I also appreciate this opportunity you've given to me to understand your culture.
You see she has obediently put on the earpiece and doesn't seem offended, so you can only follow suit and comply with the council's arrangement.

The earpiece feels somewhat uncomfortable in your ear. Half a step ahead of you, Du Ruo is strolling and looking around leisurely. You were worried these regulations would ruin her mood for the tour, but it seems you were overthinking.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Were all these buildings constructed on desert ruins?
She looks at a tall building beside the road. The trailer of a recent comedy movie is playing on its glass facade.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I've heard that to withstand disasters, most buildings in Eastside use a shear wall structure?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not too familiar with these details, but I can ask someone at the Bureau for you when we get back.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, I've heard it can counteract quicksand during construction.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I see... Standing here today, it's like a monument to human wisdom and effort.
Du Ruo seems to be attracted by something else and continues forward. You follow her gaze to a shop not far away that sells small building-shaped pendants with the word Eastside engraved on them.
You're just about to comment on the questionable design of these souvenirs when you hear Du Ruo say...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, I want to take some of these back to Eastia.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I finally know who's buying these things.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, don't look so embarrassed by your own city's souvenirs. You remind me of that saying: One who dwells among orchids does not know the fragrance.
You have a feeling that's not a compliment. But before you can ask her, a jarring electric noise explodes in your ear.

steps.speaker: Policeman
steps.content: Warning. Shopping on the roadside is not allowed. Please immediately return to the main street.
You turn to Du Ruo, but she immediately complies with the instruction and moves back to the middle of the street.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I also happen to want to check out other places.

She doesn't seem discouraged by the warning, continuing to walk at an unhurried pace. Soon, she stops in front of a 4D advertising screen as wide as two buildings which was once heavily promoted by the developer as a selling point.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I've read about this technology in books. Seeing it with my own eyes now, I wonder... did Zhou dream of becoming the butterfly? Or did it dream of becoming him?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this an ancient saying from Eastia?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yes. It means it's hard to distinguish between dreams and reality. Just like how I'm standing right in front of this screen, yet I'm uncertain if what I see is real.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That sounds a little exaggerated.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From a technical standpoint, DisCity is indeed at the forefront of the world.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I've also heard that you can construct swimming pools in the desert, and make highly immersive theatres and museums.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: These things that only exist in books... are actually realized here... DisCity truly is a miracle amid disasters. If only there were more miracles like it.
Her expression as she surveys the surroundings is one of envy and amazement, from which you can somehow also read a sigh for other hardships in the world.
Just then, a passerby holding a selfie stick squeezes in between you.
Your outfit... You must be from the Outlands, right?
I thought so when I passed by just now! Hey, I'm doing a live stream. Mind saying hi to my family?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Live stream? I've heard of it. It's one of DisCity's representative cultures.
Du Ruo raises her hand experimentally.

steps.speaker: Streamer
steps.content: Exactly! You gotta try live streaming when in Eastside. Come on, look at the camera with me...
Du Ruo taps on the various buttons on the live stream interface curiously. A variety of funny filters with flowers, kittens, and puppies appear on her face.
You watch her with amusement. Suddenly, Du Ruo turns around and grabs you, pulling you into the frame.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, join us.
Zzzt! Another warning pierces through the earpiece, the jarring sound of electricity making your head spin. Du Ruo also stops in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Policeman
steps.content: The envoy is to immediately cease interaction with the residents of DisCity. I repeat, the envoy must cease interaction with the residents of DisCity at once.

steps.speaker: Policeman
steps.content: This is the second warning. If a third warning occurs, we will take forcible measures and escort Ambassador Du Ruo back.

steps.speaker: Streamer
steps.content: Hey, why are you guys so quiet suddenly?
You and Du Ruo say nothing but simply nod apologetically to the passerby and silently retreat to the main street. The person abandons you, grumbling in confusion.
Du Ruo becomes somewhat silent. She's still observing everything around her with curiosity, occasionally striking up a conversation with you, but no longer deviating from the set path.
At this rate, even if you stroll down this street ten times from end to end, it might still not be satisfying.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wandering casually like this won't do for your academic visit, will it?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I thought I'd have the chance to chat with the people of DisCity on the street, but it seems like a pipe dream now... Nonetheless, being able to witness all this is already a great gain.
She doesn't want to make things difficult for you. But the more she's like this, the more it reminds you of the things she said and makes you feel even more indignant for her.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You call me a non-believer, and that's true. I only believe in the truth built by humans with their blood and sweat.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: For those who have witnessed devastation, the construction of such a prosperous city under the disasters is a myth in itself.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Of course. Just like the idea that mere mortals can shoot down the sun with their faith, to Eastia which lacks the protection of Hypercubes, these seemingly mundane daily experiences are as dreamy as a legend or a hope...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Du Ruo, wait for me under that billboard.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What, have you prepared a surprise for our date?

options: Yes, I want to give you a hand.

choices.text: Yes, I want to give you a hand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Take off your earpiece first. I'll be right back.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, do you know what you're doing?
You've only walked a few steps away when a reproach immediately comes through the earpiece.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course. I'm testing her credibility for you.
The councilor clearly didn't expect such a reply, and before he can continue to object, you quickly defend yourself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I haven't gone far away, and her actions have been within a controllable range. Instead of being so on edge all the time, why don't we deliberately lower our guard?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If she indeed takes the bait and does something against DisCity's interest, we'll have a legitimate reason to detain her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If she acts normally, we can play along and support the enthusiasm of a visiting scholar from Eastia.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: ...What's your plan?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You guys pretend to drop all defenses, but secretly guard all exits in the area. I'll take her to visit the surroundings of an insignificant Black Ring ruin, but we won't get close.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If she attacks me or shows any inclination to approach the Black Ring ruin during our time alone, you can immediately take your forcible measures.
Even you don't completely buy your plan, but fortunately, you know very well how to muster a firm tone and just fake it till you make it. After a long silence, the councilor finally responds.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: ...Considering your loyalty to DisCity all this time, we agree to your proposal.

You breathe a sigh of relief and turn back to see that Du Ruo is still waiting at the same spot. To your surprise, the usually resourceful and strategic scholar seems somewhat awkward and uncertain amid the hustle and bustle.
You've never fully let down your guard around her so far. For you, this is also the moment of truth.
You manage to bring Du Ruo to an abandoned high-rise in Syndicate.

The old street lamp at the base of the building flickers on and off, struggling to light up. The staircase is covered in large patches of rust. Accompanied by creaking noise, you and Du Ruo ascend to the rooftop.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, what is this place?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Look far to the right.

Moonlight shines over a vast stretch of dark rooftops of the uninhabited area. In the distant sky, lights start to come on one after another. At the end of the lights, the Statue of Keylan stands tall.
Du Ruo is somewhat dazed.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I never thought I'd be able to see Keylan Square with my own eyes...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: With all your talks about the miracles of DisCity, I thought this might be one of the places on your bucket list.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Of course, the story of Keylan has inspired so many... After all, in the face of disasters, human power is so insignificant. It wasn't until Keylan that countless scholars began to believe that the laws of the supernatural could also be conquered.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: He isn't just a beacon for DisCity. Even in the other states, he is a sacred and legendary figure...
Overlooking Syndicate's night view, Du Ruo's voice dwindles, almost as if she's whispering a sigh of admiration.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...It's a pity that I have to leave soon and won't get to see the fully restored statue.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Next time, I'd like to bring a tea table and a good teapot. We'll each have a cup, watching the moon and Keylan over the tea till the sun rises.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Must we wait until next time? It might be even harder for you to gain entry next time...

options: Why don't you stay if DisCity pleases you so much?

choices.text: Why don't you stay if DisCity pleases you so much?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Remember that question I haven't answered? Whether I want you to come back to DisCity. You have my answer now.
A trace of surprise flashes across Du Ruo's face, but it quickly disappears into a smirk and a pensive look.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh my, Chief, are you trying to abduct me? No way, I still have to go back.
She sighs exaggeratedly, gazing toward Eastia.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The Sun Crow calamity took a severe toll on all of Eastia, especially my hometown, Sunset Town. I promised Xu and those friends who sacrificed themselves in the disaster that I would pass on the myths and faiths for them, even though they were all lies.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: People have defied the impossible to rebuild a city on the ruins of Sunset Town and named it Sunsink City. They are in dire need of individuals with strong spiritual power now. I can't just abandon my hometown when it needs me the most. I can't just part with my past promises.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: That's what we Eastians are... A bunch of fools. Home is both the origin and the end.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I guess this is the end of the academic visit, then. It's time to say goodbye again. Who knows when we'll meet next.
The topic has somehow drifted from the romantic ideals back to the discouraging reality. She lowers her head, moving imperceptibly closer in your direction.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In that case, why don't I abduct you back to Eastia?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: There's no Statue of Keylan or neon-lit skyscrapers, but Goldionville's lion dance and Sunsink City's tea ceremony are worth checking out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your hometown needs you, and mine needs me too. There's plenty of trouble to deal with at the Bureau.
You try to play along with her joke, but when you look back at Du Ruo, you realize... she might not have been joking just now.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Can't you come with me? Can you really call DisCity... your hometown?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Do they really need you, or just your shackles?
Severity, earnestness, anxiety... You capture these rare emotions on Du Ruo's face.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where did that come from all of a sudden?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It's not exactly sudden. I've noticed for quite some time. ${PlayerName}, the people of DisCity trust you no more than they trust Eastia.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Though you bear the title of Chief, you actually have little power. You only got roped into the battle against the Sun Crow or my entry approval and had no say in anything. All this hometown you keep talking about wants is just...
She grabs your wrist and activates her power. She's not attacking you. On the contrary, the shackles within you seem to be summoned, mobilized, and connected to something.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What are you doing...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I'm looking for the answer in your heart. Is such a hometown really worth it?
The shackles sense the approach of powerful Mania and start to pulsate uneasily.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Du Ruo, stop. Once the shackles and the Sinner are connected, it can't be undone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I can stop, but first, answer me.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I consider Eastia my home because I was born and raised there. It's a place that has given me beautiful memories, a safe haven that gives me a sense of belonging.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But does DisCity offer you unconditional shelter? Does it feel like a mother to you, too?
It may not be intentional, but Du Ruo's words hurt. You don't know where you were born and raised. You have no past, no place to call your safe haven.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...No comment.
You try to pull your wrist away, but her grip only grows tighter.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Is it because even you can't justify why DisCity is your hometown?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: During the battle with the Sun Crow, even in the presence of the Outlanders, they were unwilling to trust you fully. If I'm not wrong, your situation during the previous Black Ring operations was even worse.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What has DisCity done to you? Surely, they must have gone further than using your shackles?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Has your so-called hometown threatened you, or even deceived you...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's none of your business.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: According to our entry agreement, you're not supposed to get involved with any information related to the Black Rings or Mania.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Du Ruo, you've broken the agreement.
Under her questioning, you've slipped up and revealed an emotional weakness. In that moment when you both waver, the shackles connect successfully. A red spike of light forms between you and Du Ruo.
She looks at you through the spike, her expression weary.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sorry, I shouldn't have probed in such a manner. It must have been hard for you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Keylan Square is enough material for the DisCity myth. The academic visit has been fruitful. Thank you... I'm a bit tired. Let's go back.
On the ride back, you both remain silent. The earpiece carries the councilor's voice, congratulating the Eastian ambassador on an eventful visit to DisCity.
Your time alone didn't result in the anticipated escape or injury. Instead, you shackled an Outland Sinner, which is a pleasant surprise for the council. But neither you nor Du Ruo are listening.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I'll be returning to Eastia in three days.
This is the last thing you hear from her at the end of her academic visit.
The next day
Nightingale knocks urgently on your office door, handing you an emergency report from the council:
Database access has been hacked by an unknown sorcery.
Seeing the adjutant's hesitant look, you immediately have a bad feeling.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where's Du Ruo?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Surveillance cameras showed that Du Ruo never left her room since returning from her academic visit. We only just discovered...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She's gone.
